name: Puppet Doll to Meitantei
source:
A short mystery novel set in a mansion.
The protagonist, Alice, is obsessed with playing detective and energetically pursues the truth behind the case.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13473]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
一部以豪宅为背景的悬疑短篇小说。
主人公爱丽丝痴迷于扮演侦探，积极追寻案件背后的真相。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13473]Novelgame[/url]]
